translation: 达到极限的；最後的；终极的
analysis:
adj [attrib 作定语]  1 beyond which no other exists or is possible; last or final 达到极限的; 最後的; 终极的: the ultimate outcome, result,conclusion, etc 最终的结局、 结果、 结论等 * Managementmust take ultimate responsibility for the strike. 资方对此次罢工该负完全的责任. * Nuclear weapons are the ultimate deterrent. 核武器是终极的威慑力量.  2 from which everything else is derived; basic or fundamental 基本的; 根本的; 首要的: ultimate principles, questions, causes 基本原理、 问题、 原因 * the ultimate truths of philosophy and science 哲学和科学的基本原则.  3 (infml 口) that cannot be surpassed or improved upon; greatest 无法超越的; 极好的; 最大的: The ultimate luxury of the trip was flying in Concorde. 这一行程中最大的享受就是乘坐协和式飞机.
ultimate
